suggested_fix.fix_text: If the agent attempts to retrieve specific plot details from external sites like IMDb or TMDB and encounters repeated timeouts or failures (e.g., >3 consecutive failures), immediately switch strategy: synthesize available partial information from successful tools (Wikipedia snippets, search results) or utilize internal knowledge to construct the answer. Do not persist in retrying the same failing endpoint.
